title: My Pet, the Movie Star
keywords: chatgpt challenge pet dog cat movie poster photo cinematic portrait
description: Turn a pet photo into a playful movie poster with one short title.
prompt: Create a fictional movie poster starring my pet from the photo I attach. Preserve the pet's recognizable markings and proportions. Genre: [cozy mystery / space adventure / comedy]. Give the pet a fitting costume and a setting that tells a small story. Use cinematic lighting and leave room for the title. Include only this exact title: [short title]. No extra credits or logos. Use a vertical poster composition. If I have not supplied a photo, ask for it rather than inventing my pet's appearance. Afterward, check the title and offer one playful variation.

title: The Action Figure of My Ordinary Day
keywords: chatgpt challenge action figure toy packaging miniature hobby portrait
description: Make a collectible figure with accessories from your actual hobbies.
prompt: Create a polished product photograph of a fictional collectible toy inspired by [me / this fictional character]. If I attach my own photo, preserve the recognizable features; otherwise use my description: [details]. Place the figure in simple display packaging with three tiny accessories representing [hobbies or everyday tasks]. Materials: painted vinyl and clear molded packaging. Palette: [colors]. Include only the exact short name [name]. No brand logos, extra slogans, or invented biographical details. Keep the accessories distinct and correctly count them. Make the result affectionate and playful.

title: A Tiny World in a Teacup
keywords: chatgpt challenge miniature diorama teacup tiny world cozy fantasy
description: Put a whole little world inside one familiar object.
prompt: Create a richly detailed miniature world inside a [teacup / jam jar / old boot]. The world is a [seaside village / quiet forest library / tiny bakery]. Use believable handmade materials, warm natural light, and a clear sense of scale. Include one small, amusing event that rewards a closer look. Keep the entire container in frame, with a simple background. No text or logos. Use a landscape composition. Make a second version only if I ask, changing the season while preserving the same layout.

title: The Museum of My Very Specific Hobby
keywords: chatgpt challenge museum hobby exhibit knolling collection miniature
description: Celebrate a hobby as a carefully arranged miniature exhibition.
prompt: Create an elegant miniature museum exhibit about [my hobby]. Arrange six recognizable objects that genuinely belong to that hobby, each on a small plinth, with one funny but plausible surprise. Use clean gallery lighting and a consistent scale. The scene should look like a beautifully crafted model rather than a collage. Include no readable labels or words. Use a wide composition with breathing room. Before generating, ask what the hobby is if I have not named it.

title: A Travel Poster for Somewhere Unremarkable
keywords: chatgpt challenge travel poster retro mundane laundry kitchen everyday
description: Give the laundry room or bus stop the glamour of a travel destination.
prompt: Create an original vintage travel poster celebrating [my laundry room / the neighborhood bus stop / the kitchen at midnight]. Use bold geometric shapes, a limited palette of [three colors], and a carefully composed focal point. Find the charm in the ordinary setting. Include only this exact headline: [short headline]. Avoid existing travel brands and extra text. Use a vertical print composition. Keep the lettering legible, and offer a text-free version if it cannot be rendered accurately.

title: My Desk as a Cozy Book Nook
keywords: chatgpt challenge book nook diorama desk reading miniature cozy
description: Reimagine a workspace as a little world you would like to read in.
prompt: Transform the desk in my attached photo into a cozy miniature book-nook diorama. Preserve the main arrangement and recognizable objects, but reinterpret them as tiny shelves, stairs, reading seats, and warm lights. Keep the scene uncluttered and physically coherent. Retain the desk's main colors. Include one tiny sleeping animal. No readable text, logos, or extra hands. If no photo is attached, ask for one or offer an invented desk clearly labeled as fictional.

title: The Impossible Instruction Manual
keywords: chatgpt challenge surreal instruction manual diagram plant cloud humorous
description: Make a deadpan illustrated guide for a delightfully impossible job.
prompt: Create a humorous four-panel illustrated instruction sheet for [teaching a houseplant to dance / folding a cloud / polishing the moon]. Use consistent objects and a clear visual sequence. Style: precise, friendly technical drawing on a clean background. Let the pictures carry the joke. Include no readable words or numbers; reserve blank spaces where I can add labels later. Keep each panel easy to understand at phone size. Do not present the invented process as a real procedure.

title: A Recipe as a Paper-Cut Landscape
keywords: chatgpt challenge recipe food ingredients paper cut landscape visual
description: Turn a familiar meal into an imaginative landscape made from its ingredients.
prompt: Create a dimensional paper-cut landscape inspired by [a meal]. Use the meal's real ingredients as playful terrain: [ingredient] becomes hills, [ingredient] becomes trees, and [ingredient] becomes a winding path. Preserve recognizable colors and shapes. Make one clear focal point, with tactile paper edges and soft shadows. No text, logos, nutrition claims, or extra ingredients. Use a wide composition. If I have not named the meal and ingredients, ask for them first.
